questions.prompt: Which hand is thick value on a completed flush board?
questions.explanation: The nut flush beats the hands that call. The others are not value.

questions.prompt: Sizing follows the hand: large with the nuts, smaller or none when…

choices.text: You have the nuts against a station
You want a worse pair to call a station

questions.explanation: If the call is always better, check. If worse calls, bet.

questions.prompt: A value bet that you will call a raise with should be…

choices.text: A very strong hand, not a thin one-pair bet.

questions.explanation: Calling a raise is a stronger claim than betting. Do not bluff-catch yourself with a thin value bet.

questions.prompt: Checking the nuts against a player who never bluffs and never bets is…

choices.text: A mistake. Bet so they can call.

questions.explanation: Traps need an opponent who will bet. If they will not, you must bet yourself.
